noncomputable def gHatQ (p : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if p ≤ 3 then 1.39953 else if p ≤ 5 then 1.36194 else if p ≤ 7 then 1.3115 else
  if p ≤ 11 then 1.24148 else if p ≤ 13 then 1.21777 else if p ≤ 17 then 1.18326 else
  if p ≤ 19 then 1.17031 else if p ≤ 23 then 1.14988 else if p ≤ 29 then 1.12806 else
  if p ≤ 31 then 1.12235 else (p : ℝ) / (p - 1) * (1 + (p : ℝ) ^ (-(2 / 3 : ℝ)))

note: Lean assumes κ_k > 0 and uses the majorant ĝ. Erratum: (12.35) as printed fails at (q, p0) = (3, 3) (lambda = 41861.5 > 34572.1) and (15, 5) (6034.13 > 6022.91), because g(p) = (p/(p-1))f_1(p) is larger at 3 (1.39953) and 5 (1.36193) than at 2 (1.34504), and its denominator is negative for tiny q (q = 1, p0 = 3: -0.101746) (checked by `scripts/checks/eq_12_35.py`).
